reviewSamples.author: Photo of JOSE TRIANA
reviewSamples.text: I’ve used Dennis many times over the years and I still use him often. He’s always punctual, professional, honest, and reliable. His prices are fair and he always does a great job. Definitely someone you can trust and I highly recommend him.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Karina Colines - Guitelman
reviewSamples.text: They've been coming to our home for the last 5 years, -always punctual- and they come more frequently if there's a bug issue. Dennis does an excellent job with follow-ups and takes care to avoid usingstandars pesticides, ensuring the safety of fruit-bearing or edible plants. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Demetri Rapanos
reviewSamples.text: Excellent service. I have been using Pest Free Home for some time. I called them because I had an infestation of roaches. The problem was quickly solved and we have been bug free ever since! They are punctual,  professional and priced very reasonably.
